description: This Java source file defines a custom exception mapper for handling JPA optimistic locking failure exceptions within the Apache Fineract project. It maps the exception to an HTTP conflict response with a structured JSON error message.

classes.name: JpaOptimisticLockExceptionMapper
classes.description: A JAX-RS exception mapper that converts JpaOptimisticLockingFailureException to a HTTP 409 Conflict response with a structured error message.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a JpaOptimisticLockingFailureException into a JAX-RS Response indicating a conflict, with an appropriate error message.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns the custom error code associated with this exception.
